decisions.decision:
Codex is out of scope. Adi dropped it on 2026-10-15, AGENTS.md covers it, and it stays untested. Run three spot checks on the local stack with simulated vendors, reusing the T-461 harness and the T-462 reviewer:
(1) Use centre_admin.py to create test attendees for RSP and for challenge. Fill each centre through the UI, pull the Day 0–3 packs, and run every prompt in a fresh `claude -p` session inside the RevOps OS.
(2) Chat edition, with no tools: feed the context prompt and each day's prompts to a plain model call, with no file or shell access. Check that every task finishes with output you can paste.
(3) Score each output against the rubric. Fix any prompt or OS file that fails, rerun it, and fix shape-specific gaps in T-456 and T-460.
Record each run (shape, prompt, pass or fail, fix commit) in the same test log T-461 writes. Commit, then move the task to review for Adi. If the chat edition from T-458 isn't built yet, run the RSP and challenge checks first.
